name: 餐饮购物
desc: 餐厅点餐、外带、买单和便利店购物的常用句
descEn: Useful phrases for ordering food, takeaway, paying, and convenience-store shopping
author: ZiTan 社区 / ZiTan Community

deaf.t: 我听不见，请看我手机屏幕
deaf.en: I'm deaf — please look at my phone
May I have a menu, please?

deaf.t: 我不要香菜和葱，请写单子上
deaf.en: No cilantro or scallions, please note it
I'd like to order this — please look at my phone
One more glass of water, please
Can I get this to go?

deaf.t: 我要这个尺码，请指给我看
deaf.en: I'd like this size — please point it out

vol.t: 这个是我们家的招牌，很多人点
vol.en: This is our signature dish, very popular

vol.t: 一共 25 元，请看我手机
vol.en: That'll be 25 — please look at my phone

vol.t: 收您 30 元，找您 5 元

vol.en: Please have a seat over here
